mentions.name: Retrography
mentions.description: An iOS app that compiles a memory journal of your days by integrating photos, motion, music, reminders, calendar, location visits, fitness, health, and sleep data. It provides drive detection, filtering of near-duplicate photos, and voice transcription for journaling, including via CarPlay.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a iOS memory of our days. Inregrates with photos, motion, music, reminders, calendar, location visits, fitness, health, sleep provides detection of drives, filtering of photos to remove near duplicates, voice transcription for journalling including carplay,… You can check it out on https://retrography.app, I am looking for free Testflight users.
